title: The Brides Wore Blood
writer: Liz Blanda, Bob Favorite, Dorothy Favorite
actors: Dolores Friedline, Chuck Faulkner, Jan Sherman
plot: "The Brides Wore Blood" is a 1972 horror movie - The DeLorca family has been cursed ever since Carlos' grandfather was interrupted while conjuring evil spirits. The curse makes each DeLorca son turn into a vampire.
